title: Share Anywhere WebSocket events
description: Server-to-client and client-to-server WebSocket messages (docs/API.md §4). Every message is a JSON text frame with a `type`. Messages carry metadata only, never file bytes, clipboard text, or ciphertext. `x-sa-phase` is the phase that delivers the event; later phases add events here before using them.

Welcome.description: First message on every connection, sent after the ticket is consumed. `server_time` lets clients correct clock skew for countdowns.
